INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Application Areas of ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Application Areas of ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Application Areas of ICT.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Application Areas of ICT.

3. When learning Operating Systems and Utilities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating Systems and Utilities.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Operating Systems and Utilities.

4. When learning Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Word Processing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing.

   D. Speaker
